name: Paul Lundberg
story: A caption in Landlink, Issue 8 (May 1999), names Paul Lundberg as a member of the middle row in a team photograph accompanying “LINZ first in mapping”. The article says the pictured team received plaques for contributions to establishing the New Zealand Topographic Digital Database and dates the four-year project to 1995 with LINZ’s predecessor DOSLI.
GeoCart 2014 accepted abstracts, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Paul Lundberg as an author of “Brief history of LINZ's NZTopo50 and NZTopo250 map series”.
